summary: Iteration 2 testing of Pine Opti v1.0 new features. Backend: 21/21 pytest passing for new endpoints (games, DNS, processes, achievements, boost-history, theme) + version label update verified. Frontend: all new pages render, sidebar has 10 nav items, GameProfiles shows 9 cards with anti-cheat tags, DNS Optimizer with 6 presets applies correctly (Activo state shown), Process Killer lists 12 processes with criticals locked, Achievements + BoostChart render on Inicio bottom, Theme picker (4 themes) works, About modal opens/closes, Command Palette (Ctrl+K) opens & navigates. All flows pass end-to-end with real API calls.

ui_bugs.issue: DNS page does not fetch user's previously-applied preset from server on mount; local state always defaults to 'isp'. After navigating away and back, the 'Activo' indicator no longer reflects the persisted choice. Apply works fine within a single session.

Similar pattern — these pages don't hydrate state from /api/user/me on mount, so any cross-session 'last applied profile/preset' is lost. Cosmetic only (Electron client would handle real persistence).

action_items: (Optional/low) DnsOptimizer/GameProfiles should fetch user's persisted preset on mount via /api/user/me (or new endpoint) so 'Activo' indicator survives re-navigation.
No required fixes — all spec items from review request are implemented and verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 677 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, games.py, dns.py, processes.py, achievements.py) before adding more features.

/api/processes/kill, /api/theme, /api/apply, /api/games/{id}/apply, /api/dns/{id}/apply all accept raw Dict[str, Any] / route params with no Pydantic schema for the body. Recommend dedicated Pydantic models (e.g., KillIn(names: List[str]), ThemeIn(theme: Literal['green','cyan','magenta','amber'])) for stronger validation + automatic 422 responses.

Achievement auto-unlock logic in GET /api/achievements computes derived flags but never persists them — fine for now, but means $addToSet only fires from apply_game_profile / apply_dns, so 'first-scan' & 'ai-chat' & 'boost-50/80' are only ever reported as unlocked, never stored. Consider unifying.
/api/boost-history uses random walk → values change every call. Frontend should cache to avoid jittery chart on re-renders, OR the endpoint should deterministically seed by date/user.
/api/processes returns randomized cpu_pct & ram_mb each call — same caching concern.
DnsOptimizer.jsx / ProcessKiller.jsx / GameProfiles.jsx default local state to 'isp' / empty Set / no selection instead of fetching server state. UX regression after re-navigation.
Sidebar v1.0 label is correct; some other pages may still embed 'v1.0' literally in JSX — single source of truth via /api/stats version would be safer for future bumps.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, Inicio v1.0 + chart + achievements, GameProfiles 9 cards + apply free-fire, DNS 6 cards + apply cloudflare, ProcessKiller 12 rows + criticals locked, Configuración 4 theme picker + About modal, Command Palette Ctrl+K + navigate to /dns, sidebar 10 nav items)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests register fresh TEST_<uuid> users per module run and apply free-fire game / cloudflare DNS / chat to verify achievement auto-unlock states.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (16 tests, v1 core) and /app/backend/tests/test_v2_features.py (21 tests, v1.0 new features). Run both with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. New routes confirmed working: /api/games (9), /api/games/{id}/apply, /api/dns (6), /api/dns/{id}/apply, /api/processes (12 with random cpu_pct), /api/processes/kill (separates safe vs critical), /api/achievements (8 total, protector always, auto-unlocks from collection state), /api/boost-history (7-day random walk seeded by user pct), /api/theme (green/cyan/magenta/amber). New frontend routes: /perfiles-juego, /dns, /procesos. Sidebar testids: nav-inicio, nav-optimizacion, nav-games, nav-herramientas, nav-dns, nav-procesos, nav-tweax, nav-backup, nav-correcciones, nav-config. Command Palette opens with Ctrl+K, input testid 'cmd-input', result items 'cmd-/path'. NOTE: Button text in this app is uppercase via CSS — Playwright inner_text returns UPPERCASE strings (e.g., 'ACTIVO', 'APLICAR'), so assertions must match case-insensitively or use uppercase.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. The only minor UX gap is that DnsOptimizer/GameProfiles/ProcessKiller default local state on mount without hydrating from server (backend persists dns_preset & applied_games, but FE doesn't read them back).
